notes.title: Dying Sun - Patch Notes #01
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
First of all, a huge thank you for your warm welcome and all your feedback on Dying Sun! This game is currently a demo, and we are continuously working on improving it based on your suggestions and our own vision. Here’s what’s new in this update:

[h3]Updates & Fixes
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated game logos to better align with the visual identity and maintain consistency with the Steam page.
[*] Tutorial translation: The tutorial is now fully translated into English.
[*] End screen update: Added a thank-you message and credits.
[*] Landmark flickering hotfix: We've implemented a temporary fix to reduce the flickering issue. We're still investigating a more permanent and efficient solution.
[/list]


[h3]Known Issues
[/h3]
[list]
[*] FPS drops: We are exploring several potential fixes but are still working on the best solution.
[*] Discord game name bug: The game’s name may not display correctly when using Discord’s rich presence feature.
[*] Various menu-related bugs: We are aware of multiple issues affecting the menus and are working to resolve them.
[/list]

We will continue debugging these issues while also adding small features and quality-of-life improvements. Stay tuned for future patch notes!

Thank you for your support and feedback!
